description: You can set up permissions and features of this module here

special.name: /moderate
special.info: Each moderator needs to be able to execute the /moderate command, so set your permissions in your server-settings accordingly. Additionally, moderator need to be entered into their level below.

content.name: logchannel-id
content.description: Moderative actions will get logged in this channel

content.name: quarantine-role-id
content.description: When a user gets quarantined, all of their roles will get removed and this quarantine-role wil get assigned

content.name: report-channel-id
content.description: Channel in which user-reports should get send. (optional, default: Log-Channel)

content.name: remove-all-roles-on-quarantine
content.description: If enabled all roles from a user get removed if they get quarantined (they get saved an can be restored with /unquarantine)

content.name: moderator-roles_level1
content.description: Moderator roles that can perform the following actions: Warn

content.name: moderator-roles_level2
content.description: Moderator roles that can perform the following actions: Warn, Mute, Unmute, Lock, Unlock, Channelmute, Remove-Channel-Mute

content.name: moderator-roles_level3
content.description: Moderator roles that can perform the following actions: Warn, Mute, Unmute, Kick, Clear

content.name: moderator-roles_level4
content.description: Moderator roles that can perform the following actions: Warn, Mute, Unmute, Kick, Clear, Ban, Unban

content.name: roles-to-ping-on-report
content.description: Roles that should get pinged in the log-channel when a user reports someone

content.name: require_reason
content.humanName: Force moderators to set a reason
content.description: Should moderators be required to set a reason?

content.name: require_proof
content.description: Should moderators be required to upload proof for their actions?

content.name: action_on_invite
content.description: What should the bot do if someone posts an invite link?

content.name: allowed_invite_guild_ids
content.description: Guild IDs whose invites should be allowed (in addition to this server's invites which are always allowed).

content.name: action_on_scam_link
content.description: What should the bot do if someone posts an suspicious or confirmed scam link?

content.name: scam_link_level
content.description: Select the Level of Scam-Link-Filter. "confirmed" only contains verified Scam-Domains, while "suspicious" may contain not-harmful domains.

content.name: whitelisted_channels_for_invite_blocking
content.description: Channels or categories where invite blocking is disabled

content.name: whitelisted_roles_for_invite_blocking
content.description: ID of Roles which are allowed to bypass invite blocking

content.name: blacklisted_words
content.description: Words that are blacklisted

content.name: action_on_posting_blacklisted_word
content.description: What should the bot do if someone posts a blacklisted word?

content.name: defaultMuteDuration
content.description: Default mute duration when none was configured. Will also be used for automod features (e.g. when someone posts a blacklisted word). Maximum value of 28 days.

content.name: changeNicknames
content.description: If enabled, the user will get renamed when they get muted or quarantined

content.name: changeNicknameOnMute
content.description: The nickname in which the user should be renamed when they get muted

content.name: changeNicknameOnQuarantine
content.description: The nickname in which the user should be renamed when they get quarantined

content.name: automod
content.description: You can define here what should happen (options: mute, kick, ban, quarantine) when someone gets x warns. Specify duration by writing :<Duration> after the action.

content.name: warnsExpire
content.description: If enabled, warns will be deleted automatically after a certain period of time. Warns expired this way will completely disappear and can not be viewed again after they expired.

content.name: warnExpiration
content.humanName: Time after which warns will be automatically removed
content.description: Warns will be automatically deleted after this value after it's creation. Please note that this action will delete existing warns if they expired. Enter an english value, such as  "1y" (= 1 year), "3 Months" (= 3 Months) oder "2w" (= 2 Weeks).
